nodes.text: Autumn Tuesday favorites 🏆 Three frames of fall that stopped my scroll. @danielslagerman @pappaga11a @heidi.undefined - beautiful work, all of you. Reel: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dewqqaoj2EX/
photos: An eye-level, medium shot depicts a dark wooden bench with concrete legs sitting on a small concrete platform facing a body of water during the autumn season. The sun is setting over the water, and its bright rays shine through the trees. The bare trees have brown and orange leaves, and a few are green. There are also yellow-green and green bushes. The ground is covered in brown and orange leaves and dirt.

Framed by the concrete pillars and metal railing of what appears to be a parking garage, a mature tree bursts with vibrant autumn foliage in shades of orange and red. The industrial architecture of the surrounding structure contrasts with the organic beauty of the changing leaves seen through the opening.
A fallen, brown autumn leaf rests on a bed of dewy grass, surrounded by a glistening field of water droplets that catch the light in a soft, dreamy blur.

replies.text: Is that bench a regular spot of yours, or a first find? @danielslagerman
Also from a parking garage - do you hunt frames there often, or did this one stop you mid-park? @pappaga11a
You mentioned wet shoes hunting that morning light - how early were you out for this one? @heidi.undefined
Around 9:25 AM! Autumn sunrises are late here (around 8 AM), so 9:25 gave me the perfect morning light and dew 📸 (Shot on Nikon Z6 III, 105mm, f/5.6, 1/250s)

nodes.text: Water Wednesday 💧 Rivers, rain on glass, ocean edges, puddles, fountains - show me water doing its thing. Framed this one through the railing at Niagara - the falls did the rest ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow and pinned to the profile, and may also be featured in an Instagram reel or weekend IG roundup with full credit. Best of the week lands on Instagram on the weekend.
photos: A framed view of Niagara Falls viewed through a metal spiral.

A wide shot captures a coastal slipway on an overcast day, with people gathered on the pier and swimming in the dark water. In the distance, flat-topped mountains rise across the bay beneath a dramatic sky heavy with clouds.

A vertical shot features thin streams of water pouring from a stone ledge into a fountain pool below, each stream creating expanding concentric ripples. Scattered autumn leaves rest on the stone ledge and in the water near the right edge of the frame.

replies.text: Lake Michigan 😎❣️
photos: A small wave breaks along the sandy shoreline under a bright sky. In the distance, a dark breakwater cuts across the water beneath a horizon line that meets the pale clouds.

A close-up shot captures a cluster of green and reddish leaves, heavily speckled with dew drops, glistening under the natural light. The background is softly blurred with hints of other foliage, creating a serene and natural ambiance ideal for a nature-loving post.

replies.text: The water of the Erie Canal, reflecting the lights of Schoen Place at blue hour.
photos: A high-angle twilight shot shows a calm river mirroring the warm lights of a waterfront town in Pittsford, New York, captured by Charles O. Perez. The tranquil scene features a tall, slender grain elevator on the left, boats moored along the banks, and a deep blue sky transitioning into dusk.
An icy rock, resembling a frozen phoenix rising from dark blue water, rests in the middle of a river. The river bank is covered in white snow, emphasizing the cold, wintery environment.
A close-up vertical shot of two glistening water droplets clinging to the tips of a vibrant green leaf, illuminated by sunlight.
A night shot captures a starry sky over a body of water, with a rocky shoreline in the foreground. A few faint lights twinkle on the horizon across the water.

A wide-angle, slightly low-angle, eye-level shot captures a moody, overcast day along the water. In the background, across a wide body of water, a cluster of smokestacks from a power plant or industrial facility billows white smoke into the dramatic gray clouds. To the left, a line of tall trees with hints of changing autumn colors edges the shoreline, which is a mix of dirt, rocks, and a concrete boat ramp in the foreground. On the right, a tall, white concrete or metal pole stands upright, stretching vertically into the frame. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by grays, browns, and dull greens under a heavy, overcast sky.
This vertical shot shows a calm river under a bright blue sky, with three white pillars on a concrete bank to the right and lush green trees casting dappled shadows on the ground to the left.

replies.text: Great Falls Virginia USA
photos: A vertical, eye-level shot captures a river rushing through a rocky landscape on a bright, sunny day, with a line of lush green trees on the horizon under a clear blue sky. White foam crests the dark water as it tumbles over jagged gray boulders, highlighting the powerful currents.

A calm, shallow body of water flows toward the ocean between a rocky, tree-lined cliff on the left and a sandy beach on the right, under a partly cloudy blue sky. A few people can be seen in the distance on the black rocks where the river meets the sea.

A bright, overcast sky casts a silvery glare over rippling water, with distant land visible on the horizon. In the foreground, a dark stone sea wall lines a paved path, creating a tranquil coastal scene.

A rusted, old iron anchor lies on a grassy hill, with a stone wall to its left and the sea in the background. Framing the view through the anchor's loop, a distant lighthouse stands on a pier under a partly cloudy sky.
A long-exposure photograph captures the moody atmosphere of the Giant's Causeway in Northern Ireland, where iconic hexagonal basalt columns emerge from a misty, glass-like sea under a twilight sky.

replies.text: Basalt columns walking straight into a glassy sea. Does the Causeway ever get a quiet evening, or did you win the timing lottery?

photos: A vibrant golden sunset filters through the silhouettes of tall pine trees, casting a warm glow over a serene lake. In the foreground, fallen pine needles scatter across the ground, completing this picturesque, peaceful nature scene.

replies.text: Sunset doing all the work through those pines. Is that a local lake or a found one?
Actually, it’s the Saco River in Dayton, Maine.

photos: A high-angle, vertical shot captures lily pads and tiny yellow flowers scattered across the dark water of a pond. The water surface reflects the blue sky, creating a peaceful atmosphere.
A tranquil stream flows through a lush autumn forest, its banks lined with vibrant yellow and red foliage. Fallen leaves cover the ground, creating a serene and picturesque seasonal landscape.

A long stone and stucco bridge spans a calm body of water, featuring a row of arched openings along the lower level and rectangular windows on the upper floor, with its architecture clearly mirrored on the glassy water's surface beneath a bright blue sky.

replies.text: Three for one - the bridge with its mirror twin is my pick of the set. Where is that? It looks purpose-built for reflections.

photos: Framed by the cutouts of a white concrete wall, a motorboat speeds across sparkling blue water under a bright sky with scattered clouds.

replies.text: A boat, framed by the wall itself. Did you spot the cutout first or the boat?

photos: A serene alpine lake reflects a dense forest of evergreen trees and a clear blue sky, framed by gentle mountain slopes under bright daylight.

replies.text: The lake doubling the whole forest. Windless mornings like that feel rigged.

photos: Waves gently lap against a rugged, rocky shoreline bordering a vibrant turquoise sea. In the distance, two small sailboats are visible on the horizon under a clear sky.

replies.text: Turquoise like that should require a permit. Local shore or a trip?
Trip to Key West! Amazing!!
Key West is amazing. I have been there once and it was a great place.

photos: A low-angle, eye-level shot looks through splashing water at the Schönbrunn Palace in Vienna, Austria, with tourists walking through its grand, flower-lined gardens in the distance. The bright daylight is slightly obscured by the water's mist, while the sky above is mostly blue with scattered fluffy white clouds.

replies.text: Shot through the spray, palace and all. Did the lens stay dry?
Shot with just a phone camera. There is a little space behind the fountain that I found with the view of the palace. Most people wander by without knowing it’s there.
The quiet of a Muskoka evening
photos: A small boat rests tied to a wooden dock on a calm lake, with another dock visible further out. The sun breaks through dramatic, scattered clouds at sunset, casting a golden reflection on the water's surface.

replies.text: Muskoka evenings showing off again. That boat has the best seat in Ontario.

photos: A high-angle view from a hot air balloon basket captures a winding river flowing through a dry, scrubby landscape under a clear blue sky. Vertical red and black straps hang in the foreground, framing the serene aerial view.

A man wearing a dark baseball cap and an olive green hoodie looks out from a hot air balloon basket at a winding river below, flanked by grassy banks. The bright blue sky and clear weather suggest an ideal morning for a scenic flight.

replies.text: A river from a balloon basket beats any window seat. Was the landing as graceful as the view?

photos: A wide, ice-covered river winds through a dense, snow-dusted forest of evergreen and deciduous trees on an overcast winter day. In the foreground, vibrant red branches reach up from the bank, adding a pop of color to the monochromatic landscape.

replies.text: The red branches refusing to do winter quietly. Frozen solid, or still moving under the ice?
There’s still water moving under the ice.
So cool 👍

photos: A vibrant, magenta water lily floats on the dark, reflective surface of a pond, nestled between two large, bright green lily pads. In the background, a scattered field of lily pads creates a peaceful, sunlit nature scene.

replies.text: That magenta is not being subtle about anything. Your pond or a garden visit?
Just a lake we were kayaking on ❤️￼

photos: A large suspension bridge spans across calm water at sunset, with a white, green, and blue ferry crossing beneath its towers. Hilly terrain is visible in the background under a pale yellow sky.

replies.text: The ferry timed its crossing perfectly for you. Planned, or right place, right minute?
Rather, I'm in the right place at the right time, everything came together: sunset, bridge, ferry, ocean and San Francisco

photos: A grey heron takes flight across a serene pond, its wings spread wide as it skims just above the reflective water surface. The peaceful scene is set against a backdrop of bare winter trees under a clear blue sky, capturing a quiet moment in nature.

replies.text: Caught it mid-launch, wings already committed. Reflexes or patience?
Neither really , I was taking a picture of the reflection and the bird photobombed me
Haaa, he wanted to be in the nice shot 🤭
Barden Lake, Tonbridge, Kent, UK.
photos: A high-angle, eye-level shot captures a vibrant body of water under a clear blue sky, with a lush, green island in the distance. The shoreline in the foreground teems with a lively gathering of ducks and birds, their feathers gleaming in the bright sunlight.

replies.text: The whole duck committee showed up. Is that a daily summit at Barden Lake?
Nerano, Italy. On the Sorrento Peninsula. Tuesday (yesterday) morning) 😁
photos: A high angle shot captures a pebble beach with a small pier, with several small boats floating in the water. The sun sets behind a lush, dark green hill with buildings on it, illuminating the sea with a soft glow.

replies.text: Shot yesterday morning and already looking like a postcard. Worth the early alarm?

photos: An abstract view of ripples moving across clear water, with reflections of trees and rocks underneath.

replies.text: Pure ripples, no subject needed. Hard to stop watching these once you start.
Cinque Terre Italy
photos: (description unavailable: blocked by Gemini, reason: PROHIBITED_CONTENT)
Two fishermen stand on a dark, sandy beach with sparse vegetation, casting lines into a vast ocean with frothy, white-capped waves blurred by long exposure.

replies.text: Two fishermen, and a sea doing its best impression of the sky. That long exposure turned the surf into clouds - I had to look twice.
Many attemots made as the fishermen kept moving. Shot from a kilometer away on a 300mm
That’s how much effort for a nice picture

photos: A close-up shot of water droplets on a smooth surface against a gray background, creating a moody, contemplative atmosphere.

replies.text: Droplets doing minimalism. A whole subject in a puddle's worth of water.

photos: A lone fisherman stands on a wet sandy beach at sunset, with two fishing rods propped up next to a bucket and the ocean in the background. The sky is painted with vibrant orange and pink hues, creating a serene and picturesque coastal scene.

replies.text: One fisherman, two rods, and that sky. Did the fish cooperate at all?
Probably not 🤣

photos: At dusk, several boats are docked in a harbor, with their bright lights reflecting on the dark water.

replies.text: Harbor lights doubled on the water. Dusk is that place's best hour.

photos: A man calmly reads a newspaper on a bench with his feet dangling in the flooded water of the River Thames. Nearby, several seagulls perch on wooden posts, unbothered by the high water level.

replies.text: Feet in the Thames, paper in hand, completely unbothered - him and the gulls both. Is that a regular high-tide ritual there?

photos: A brilliant yellow sunset dips below a distant coastline, its last rays casting a warm glow across a dark, choppy body of water.

replies.text: Last rays over choppy water. The day went out swinging.
Jesus 🙏🙏❤️❤️ God bless you and your family, thank you

photos: A solitary bird flies across the frame as the sun sets over a calm harbor, illuminating a large, dramatic cloud formation in the background. The golden light reflects off the water, highlighting a wooden pier and a small building in the distance.

replies.text: The bird crossed right on cue. That cloud was doing enough drama for the whole harbor.

photos: A vertically-oriented, medium close-up shot captures several icicles hanging from the branches of a pine tree covered in snow. The icicles in the foreground are sharp and clear, while those in the background are blurred. The pine tree's needles are covered in a light layer of snow, and the icicles hang vertically from the branches. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the icicles and the snow-covered pine needles.

replies.text: Water Wednesday, frozen edition. Those icicles are sharper than the pine needles.
Great framing

photos: A close-up shot captures scattered raindrops glistening on a dark, wet surface. The background features a softly blurred, abstract scene with hints of blue, green, and orange.

replies.text: Raindrops doing their glisten. What surface caught them this well?

photos: Two people are standing on a rocky beach on an overcast day, surrounded by driftwood and water.
A tour boat packed with sightseers framed by the twisted metal scroll of a railing overlooking the churning waters of Niagara Falls.
Raindrops create overlapping concentric ripples on the surface of a shallow puddle on grey concrete.

replies.text: The Niagara boat framed by that railing scroll - I know that trick, I used it for today's hero. Great minds at the same railing?

photos: A wide-angle, low-angle, eye-level, horizontal shot captures a motorized boat with a simple roof canopy sitting on deep blue water, silhouetted against a bright sunrise, in Baja, Mexico. The boat is positioned on the right third of the frame, facing left. The sun shines brightly in the upper left corner, casting rays across the blue sky and water. Gentle ripples cover the water's surface, reflecting the sunlight. Silhouetted figures are visible in the boat, with one person in the front and two or three at the back. Far in the distance on the left, a light-colored mountain range is faintly visible under the hazy sky.

replies.text: Baja sunrise, boat silhouetted, sun doing the spotlight work. You collect good mornings.
Superb!
Rain on the screen
photos: A bright golden light shines through a rain-streaked window, illuminating water droplets against a dark, tree-lined backdrop. The distorted view creates an abstract, fiery effect from the light filtering through the wet glass.

replies.text: Rain on the screen turned the light into fire. Inside looking out never looked warmer.

nodes.snippet: Autumn Tuesday 🍂 Show me your best autumn shot. Red trees, …
nodes.text: Autumn Tuesday 🍂 Show me your best autumn shot. Red trees, golden leaves, foggy mornings, pumpkins, whatever fall looks like where you are. Caught this one from a parking garage - autumn framing the view. ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow and pinned to the profile, and may also be featured in an Instagram reel or weekend IG roundup with full credit. Follow for more prompts.
photos: A view of a foggy autumn day featuring vibrant red ivy framing a window opening. The misty background reveals tall evergreen and deciduous trees against a muted gray sky.
A multi-story stone building features ivy transitioning from green to red. Cars park along the street in front of the building.

replies.text: An autumn in a dream! How did you shoot this? Is that a special kind of lens?
I took this photo with an ancient Android phone where you could set this kind of blur effect in the camera.
I see. Quite a fit for the scene!

photos: A high-angle view captures a winding stream flowing through a rocky gorge in autumn, its banks and ledges blanketed with vibrant yellow and orange fallen leaves. Several people stand on a stone pathway carved into the cliffside in the upper right, admiring the scenic landscape.

replies.text: A gorge dressed head to toe in fall. Did you hike down to the stream, or is the cliff path the best seat?
The cliff path and steps to the path.
Door Co., WI
photos: A low-angle view captures a forest canopy in peak autumn color, with vibrant orange, red, and yellow leaves illuminated by the morning sun. Beams of sunlight pierce through the trees, casting a warm, glowing light on the forest floor below.

replies.text: Peak color from underneath - the canopy doing its stained-glass impression. How long did that light hold?
Not long at all. Pictures like this remind me of how light will maybe be that way for a short time and the picture I got will never be taken again.

photos: A serene landscape photo captures a lake reflecting a cloudy blue sky under dramatic, puffy clouds. In the background, a line of trees adorned with autumn foliage stands tall, while tall grass peeks through the water in the foreground, enhancing the natural beauty of the scene.

replies.text: Clouds doing double duty - once in the sky, once on the water. Did the lake stay that calm, or catch this in a lucky pause?
Very early in the morning before it got wavy!
Great effort!

photos: A rustic, weathered wooden lighthouse stands against a vibrant backdrop of autumn foliage, with rich red, orange, and yellow trees blanketing the hillside. The historical structure, featuring a stone foundation and dark, boarded-up windows, is positioned along a calm shoreline under an overcast sky.

replies.text: A lighthouse that retired into the perfect autumn backdrop. Still standing watch, or fully off duty these days?

photos: A close-up shot captures vibrant, fiery red autumn leaves hanging from branches, creating a striking contrast against a softly blurred background of green and earthy tones. Sunlight illuminates the leaves, highlighting their detailed textures and the arrival of the autumn season.

replies.text: Red, lit from inside. Is that one tree showing off, or a whole hillside turning?
It was one tree showing off.

photos: A calm lake mirrors a snow-dusted mountain range under a cloudy sky, with autumn foliage lining the far shore. In the foreground, a grassy bank with a patch of stone pavers and rocks borders the water's edge.

replies.text: Snow on top, autumn on the shore - two seasons sharing one lake. Was that a cold morning?
It was a chilly day, early November a couple of years ago at Loch Venacher.

photos: A small New England town features a white church with a tall steeple, situated next to a parking lot and a two-lane road at dusk. In the background, a mountain ridge is lit up by the warm glow of the setting sun, contrasting with the cool blue and gray clouds in the sky above.

replies.text: The ridge kept the last of the sun while the town went blue. How long did that light hang on?
It's actually sunrise, but the same thing, only lasted about ten minutes
🤭🤭🤭 reminds me, there are always 2 golden hours in a day 😂

photos: A vibrant red amanita mushroom with white spots stands out amidst the earthy tones of a forest floor, surrounded by fallen twigs, moss, and pine needles. The forest floor is dappled with sunlight, creating an inviting and magical woodland scene.
A close-up captures an oak tree branch laden with clusters of acorns nestled among green and yellowing autumn leaves.

replies.text: A storybook mushroom, and acorns by the cluster - autumn brought props. Do the amanitas pop up in the same spot every year?
Google say yes!😉😃

photos: A vertical, medium, eye-level shot captures a white church with brown doors and an enormous red tree in autumn foliage. The church is situated on the left, its white siding and dark shingle roof contrasting with the vibrant red leaves of the large tree on the right. The church's white door is closed and has two panels, each with small wooden slats. The tree's leaves are a brilliant red, some turning orange towards the top, creating a vivid display of autumn colors. The ground in front of the church and tree is covered with fallen red leaves. The sky above is a bright, overcast white.

replies.text: That tree is upstaging the whole church. Does it turn this red every year, or is this a special one?
Every year. It’s up the coast in Bolinas.
My Ginkgo Biloba has turned golden💛
photos: A vibrant ginkgo tree with bright, golden-yellow fan-shaped leaves stands against a clear blue sky. The sunlight illuminates the canopy, showcasing the changing autumn foliage in full display.

replies.text: A ginkgo in full gold is hard to beat. How long does yours hold before the famous drop?

photos: A close-up of vibrant red autumn leaves climbing a weathered stone wall, interspersed with small clusters of dark berries. Sunlight casts soft shadows across the foliage, highlighting the rich seasonal colors and natural textures.

replies.text: That wall got dressed for the season. Do the berries stay that dark all fall?
The berries stay dark and get eaten by birds before long
Also from a parking garage!
photos: A tree with vibrant red autumn leaves is framed by a concrete architectural opening, creating a striking contrast between industrial structure and natural beauty. The composition captures the essence of the fall season, viewed from what appears to be a parking garage or balcony.

replies.text: Parking garages: the unofficial autumn observatories. Did you spot it driving in, or on the way out?
I think driving in! One of those moments the photographer’s eye catches.

photos: A stone wall with three arched windows overlooks a cityscape with modern buildings. The old, weathered stonework contrasts sharply with the contemporary skyline visible through the empty frames.

replies.text: Three windows, three eras of the same city. Did you take this one in fall?
Hi... took it in late winter..

photos: A wooden footbridge with metal railings spans a stream in a lush forest on an autumn day. The trees in the background are transitioning to vibrant shades of orange, yellow, and green.

replies.text: That bridge is doing autumn's PR work. Did you cross it, or just stop and admire it?
I crossed it! Not much to report on the other side unfortunately.

photos: A vertical shot captures a path lined with a traditional white and tiled wall, overhung by brilliant autumn foliage of yellow and red maple leaves in Kyoto, Japan. In the background, out-of-focus tourists stroll near a temple entrance, adding a touch of life to the vibrant seasonal scene.

replies.text: Kyoto showing off again. Was that peak color, or still warming up?
Feel like peak color
photos: A vertical close-up shot captures vibrant golden-orange Japanese maple leaves on slender branches, contrasting with the dark red and purple fallen leaves blanketing the ground below, creating a cozy autumn scene.
A lush canopy of vibrant red Japanese maple leaves is viewed from above against a dense carpet of fallen autumn foliage.

replies.text: Peak, and you brought the proof. That red canopy over the fallen leaves - is the whole path like that?

photos: A vibrant tree with golden-orange autumn foliage stands prominently beside a harvested field under a deep blue sky filled with wispy, streaked white clouds. A paved road curves alongside the tree, completing a quintessential rural landscape scene.

replies.text: That tree owns the whole road. Peak color there, or just getting started?
That one is peak. It’s from another year. I visited yesterday and colour is nowhere as far along this year yet.

photos: A medium shot captures a carved pumpkin with large eyes and a jagged smile sitting on a wooden surface in a softly lit room. The pumpkin is illuminated from the inside, casting a warm glow, and a row of smaller photo thumbnails is visible across the bottom of the screen.

replies.text: Halloween 🎃 on a screen shot? 🤨
Oops! Forgot to clean it up once I moved it over to my phone!!

photos: A large maple tree bursts with vibrant red and orange autumn foliage under a clear blue sky. A solitary picnic table rests quietly in the dappled shade beneath its branches, surrounded by a carpet of fallen leaves.

A top-down, medium shot shows a dried, tan-colored maple seed, or samara, against a light-colored, textured background. The samara is positioned vertically, with the wing expanding upwards and to the right, and the seed end pointing towards the bottom left. The wing features delicate, slightly raised veins running from the base to the edge, creating a striped pattern of light and shadow.
A tight arrangement of vibrant yellow and deep red marigolds sits upright in a small glass vase decorated with blue yarn.

replies.text: A whole autumn starter kit - the big maple, its seeds, and marigolds for backup. Which of the three is your favorite?
The big maple.🍁
Big maple it is 😌 very autumn 🍁

photos: A middle-aged man in a dark grey sweatshirt and trousers sits perched on a low stone wall, drinking from a green glass bottle with a red stopper. He is framed by bright red autumn leaves on the left, with more scattered across the wall beneath him, against a soft background of lush green trees.

replies.text: The red leaves framed him better than any studio backdrop. Did he know he was the model, or was that a lucky catch?
He did. We did a three day shoot at the winery he works at. I always prefer to say its a lucky catch but this was well set up
Nice work 👍

photos: A wooden bench sits on a concrete overlook, facing a serene lake surrounded by vibrant autumn foliage. The low sun bursts through the branches of the trees, casting a warm glow and long shadows across the ground.

replies.text: That bench has the best seat in autumn. Did you sit for a while, or take the photo and go?

photos: A single, reddish-brown fallen leaf rests on green grass heavily dusted with dew. The background is a soft blur of bokeh, creating a peaceful, autumnal atmosphere.

replies.text: One leaf, first dew, the whole season in a single frame. Early morning hunt, or did it find you?
This was me out hunting the morning light! And I can tell you, I ended up with very wet shoes. Totally worth it for moments like this, though. ✨
Very nice clear up, great effort! Thanks for sharing it!
* close up 😂😂😂

photos: A vibrant red maple leaf floats in calm, glassy water, surrounded by other fallen autumn leaves in shades of yellow and brown. The scene captures the quiet, reflective beauty of a crisp fall day.

replies.text: The big red one is running the whole pond. Did it pop like that in person, or is autumn showing off?
I was looking for small things along the shoreline yesterday on the walk around the pond, saw this guy and stopped immediately lol Yes it definitely stood out
Cool color 👍

nodes.label: train, station, platform, week
nodes.snippet: Best of the week is up on Instagram as a reel. Five favorit…
nodes.text: Best of the week is up on Instagram as a reel. Five favorites from this week's prompts — night station, mirrored tree, courting egrets, golden-hour hens, bison. Which one stopped you? https://www.instagram.com/reel/Demg-VTj14Q/
photos: A low-angle, street-level shot captures a train platform at night, with the text "BEST OF THE WEEK" overlaid in the upper portion. The textured ground fills the foreground, while a train with white, red, and yellow stripes sits on the left alongside an arched, brightly lit canopy overhead.

A bright blue vertical sign reading "JAKARTA KOTA" stands out in the foreground of a mostly empty train station platform. The station features an industrial white-painted steel and wooden roof structure overhead, overlooking a set of parallel train tracks.

replies.text: That blue could stop a train. Was the platform really that empty, or just perfectly timed?
